// Category name translations
const categoryNames = {
  'alpine-skiing': {
    en: 'Alpine Skiing', de: 'Ski Alpin', fr: 'Ski Alpin', it: 'Sci Alpino',
    es: 'Esquí Alpino', pt: 'Esqui Alpino', nl: 'Alpineskiën', ar: 'التزلج على المنحدرات',
    ja: 'アルペンスキー', zh: '高山滑雪', ko: '알파인 스키'
  },
  'biathlon': {
    en: 'Biathlon', de: 'Biathlon', fr: 'Biathlon', it: 'Biathlon',
    es: 'Biatlón', pt: 'Biatlo', nl: 'Biathlon', ar: 'البياتلون',
    ja: 'バイアスロン', zh: '冬季两项', ko: '바이애슬론'
  },
  'cross-country': {
    en: 'Cross-Country', de: 'Langlauf', fr: 'Ski de fond', it: 'Sci di fondo',
    es: 'Esquí de fondo', pt: 'Esqui cross-country', nl: 'Langlaufen', ar: 'التزلج الريفي',
    ja: 'クロスカントリー', zh: '越野滑雪', ko: '크로스컨트리'
  },
  'athletes': {
    en: 'Athletes', de: 'Athleten', fr: 'Athlètes', it: 'Atleti',
    es: 'Atletas', pt: 'Atletas', nl: 'Atleten', ar: 'الرياضيون',
    ja: '選手', zh: '运动员', ko: '선수'
  }
};

const article = $input.first().json;
const lang = article.langCode;
const ui = uiStrings[lang] || uiStrings.en;

// Extract content for this language
const title = article.title[lang] || article.title.en;
const excerpt = article.excerpt?.[lang] || article.excerpt?.en || '';
const content = article.content[lang] || article.content.en;
const metaDesc = article.meta_description?.[lang] || article.meta_description?.en || excerpt;

// Get category name
const categoryName = categoryNames[article.category]?.[lang] || article.category;

// Calculate reading time (rough estimate: 200 words per minute)
const wordCount = content.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, '').split(/\s+/).length;
const readingMinutes = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(wordCount / 200));
const readingTime = ui.readingTime.replace('{min}', readingMinutes);

// Format published date
const pubDate = new Date(article.published_at);
const dateFormatters = {
  en: { month: 'long', day: 'numeric', year: 'numeric' },
  de: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  fr: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  it: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  es: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  pt: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  nl: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  ar: { day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric' },
  ja: { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' },
  zh: { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' },
  ko: { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }
};
const publishedDate = pubDate.toLocaleDateString(lang, dateFormatters[lang] || dateFormatters.en);

// Language selector
const langSelected = {};
['en','de','fr','it','es','pt','nl','ar','ja','zh','ko'].forEach(l => {
  langSelected[l] = l === lang ? 'selected' : '';
});

return {
  json: {
    slug: article.slug,
    lang: lang,
    langPath: article.langPath,
    dir: article.langDir,
    outputPath: article.langPath ? `${article.langPath}${article.slug}/index.html` : `${article.slug}/index.html`,
    
    // Article content
    title: title,
    excerpt: excerpt,
    content: content,
    metaDescription: metaDesc,
    publishedISO: article.published_at,
    publishedDate: publishedDate,
    readingTime: readingTime,
    
    // Category
    category: article.category,
    categoryName: categoryName,
    
    // Structured data
    structuredData: JSON.stringify(article.structured_data || {}, null, 2),
    
    // UI strings
    ui: ui,
    
    // Language selector states
    langSelected: langSelected
  }
};

// HTML Template - Read from file or use inline const template = ` {{title}} - Bronze {{ui.skipLink}}
Bronze
  • {{ui.navNews}}
  • {{ui.navAlpine}}
  • {{ui.navBiathlon}}
  • {{ui.navAthletes}}
  • {{ui.navApp}}
{{ui.navNews}} › {{categoryName}} › {{title}}
{{categoryName}}

{{title}}

{{publishedDate}} {{readingTime}}
{{content}}

{{ui.appBannerTitle}}

{{ui.appBannerText}}

{{ui.appBannerCta}}
{{ui.footerApp}} {{ui.footerPrivacy}} {{ui.footerSupport}} X @bronzenews Instagram

© 2026 Bronze. {{ui.footerDisclaimer}}

`; const data = $input.first().json; // Simple template replacement let html = template; // Replace simple values html = html.replace(/\{\{lang\}\}/g, data.lang); html = html.replace(/\{\{dir\}\}/g, data.dir); html = html.replace(/\{\{slug\}\}/g, data.slug); html = html.replace(/\{\{langPath\}\}/g, data.langPath); html = html.replace(/\{\{title\}\}/g, data.title); html = html.replace(/\{\{excerpt\}\}/g, data.excerpt); html = html.replace(/\{\{metaDescription\}\}/g, data.metaDescription); html = html.replace(/\{\{publishedISO\}\}/g, data.publishedISO); html = html.replace(/\{\{publishedDate\}\}/g, data.publishedDate); html = html.replace(/\{\{readingTime\}\}/g, data.readingTime); html = html.replace(/\{\{category\}\}/g, data.category); html = html.replace(/\{\{categoryName\}\}/g, data.categoryName); html = html.replace(/\{\{structuredData\}\}/g, data.structuredData); html = html.replace(/\{\{content\}\}/g, data.content); // Replace UI strings for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data.ui)) { html = html.replace(new RegExp(`\\{\\{ui\\.${key}\\}\\}`, 'g'), value); } // Replace language selected states for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(data.langSelected)) { html = html.replace(new RegExp(`\\{\\{langSelected\\.${key}\\}\\}`, 'g'), value); } return { json: { outputPath: data.outputPath, html: html, lang: data.lang, slug: data.slug } };
